title: 1. Who we are and how to contact us
paragraphs: Westmere Careers is a service operated by Louis Jacques Pierre Sibul, a sole trader trading as Westmere Systems, ABN 16 319 214 903 (Westmere, we, us or our).

Our Privacy Officer is responsible for privacy enquiries, requests and complaints. Email support@westmere.com.au or write to Privacy Officer, Westmere Systems, Suite 1208/530 Little Collins Street, Melbourne, VIC 3000, Australia. You can also request an alternative accessible way to communicate with us.

This policy explains how we collect, hold, use and disclose personal information when you browse our website, use a candidate or employer account, prepare or submit applications, use Careers+ and Careers+ Studio, report an application experience, or contact us. It also explains overseas processing, your choices and how to raise a concern.

We handle personal information in accordance with applicable Australian privacy laws. These include the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) where applicable, and the Health Records Act 2001 (Vic) and its Health Privacy Principles where we handle health information within its scope. Any Victorian public sector privacy obligations apply to us only to the extent the law or a relevant government services arrangement makes them applicable. Nothing in this policy excludes a legal right or obligation.

This policy explains our practices; reading it or using the website does not, by itself, give consent to marketing, sensitive-information collection or optional AI processing. We obtain any consent required for the particular activity separately.

title: 2. The information we collect
paragraphs: Personal information includes information or an opinion about an identified or reasonably identifiable person, whether accurate or not. Depending on the features you use, we collect the following kinds of information.

Accounts and profiles. Your name, email address, account identifier, saved profile and CV text, account creation and update times, authentication and session records, and account or subscription status. We ask you to add a name when completing a new account. Email sign-in uses a one-time code rather than a Westmere password. If you choose an available Google or Microsoft sign-in option, we receive the identity information permitted by the sign-in request, such as your verified email address, provider identifier and name. We do not request access to your email inbox, cloud documents or contacts for sign-in. We also record requested and confirmed account-email changes.

Career and application information. The information you put in your CV, cover letter, application answers or career goals; CV documents you deliberately upload in supported PDF or Word (.docx) format; the text extracted from them; their original filename, file type, size, upload time and version history; and your selected CV version. The fields you choose to include can contain contact details, education, qualifications, employment history, skills, achievements, work preferences and referee details. We do not require every one of these details; what we receive depends on what you choose to include. For a direct application, we also collect the job and employer identifiers, a copy of the submitted material, role details at submission, submission time, application stage and withdrawal time.

Application activity and employer updates. Recorded receipt and first intentional opening events, the account associated with an action, event times, application decisions and messages entered by authorised hiring team members. We store the personal information that hiring teams include in their messages and decisions.

Employer accounts and listings. Employer organisation details, representative account identifiers, organisation membership and permission levels, job advertisements and formatted text, publication status, salary and role requirements, optional contact emails, uploaded profile images and banners, supporting listing documents, and information provided in business verification or support correspondence. Company information can be personal information where it identifies a sole trader or individual representative. A listing or organisation profile is intended for public display; do not include private candidate information in it. Contact email shown after a click is still publicly disclosed and can be copied; hiding it behind a button does not make it private.

Experience reports. Your account and relevant application or job reference, employer, application date, whether a response was received, response date, the source of the report, confirmation time and moderation status. These reports are separate from activity recorded by Westmere.

Careers+ and payments. Your email address and account reference, Stripe customer, subscription and checkout references, price and subscription status, billing-period dates, cancellation status and limited payment-event and reconciliation records. Stripe separately collects payment details and any billing, verification and fraud-prevention information required for its services.

Preparation tools. CV text, task selection, optional goals and supplied role title or description used for a requested comparison or AI review, and the resulting suggestions. We also record account-linked AI allowance records, including request mode, status, billing period and relevant times. Those allowance records do not contain your CV or the generated text.

Website and security information. Our hosting, authentication and delivery providers process IP addresses, browser and device information, request URLs, search parameters, timestamps, errors, authentication events and security or delivery logs. Search filters can reveal career interests. Location filters contain the location you enter; the site does not request precise device geolocation, camera or microphone access.

Communications and preferences. The contact details and content you provide when you communicate with us, associated correspondence, in-site notifications and read status, service-email delivery records, and optional saved-search alert preferences, matching filters, consent and unsubscribe records. Avoid putting unnecessary sensitive information in ordinary email.

Upload safeguards record account-linked attempt times and short-lived processing reservations to limit concurrent or excessive file processing. These safeguards do not contain the CV text. An invited private sample hiring workspace uses synthetic applicants and separate sample roles. A deliberately requested notification preview is addressed only to that account’s verified email and is rate limited.

Free AI previews. When you request a guest or free-account review, we record a keyed, pseudonymous allowance identifier, trial tier, reservation status and relevant times. Signed-in trial records also reference your account. A separate daily keyed network identifier helps limit abuse and preview costs. The quota ledger contains no raw IP address, CV text or generated result. Paid billing-period allowances continue to use separate account-linked records.

Business onboarding and verification. We record your business-account type, trading name, authenticated email reference, Terms version, document fingerprint and acceptance time. Verification requests also collect the LinkedIn profile supplied, your role, ABN and website, publicly listed HR or business verification email and phone, the public source page, your explanation of authority and your permission for us to contact that business. Provide contacts you are authorised to share, tell the contact person that you are providing their details for verification and do not provide private home contact details. Verification contacts are restricted to you and authorised reviewers; they are not automatically published on your company profile or used for marketing. A public company description, website, social links and uploaded company images are separate information intended for publication. Business-plan and order references support access controls and service administration.

Testing and billing administration. Dedicated test-account designation, the operator making an assignment, selected test tier, start and expiry times and a reason are recorded in a restricted audit log. Test assignments are separate from paid subscriptions and grant no business verification. Business billing uses a separate organisation customer and owner permission check; conversion from a personal account does not transfer a personal payment method. We receive limited payment-method details such as brand, last four digits and expiry, invoice status and authenticated Stripe-hosted invoice links to show to the billing owner. Refund, dispute and fraud-warning events can be recorded for authorised billing review; a warning is not treated as proof of fraud.

Listing lifecycle and candidate-pool activity. We record listing publication, archive, expiry and renewal times, the company and listing identifiers, the acting employer account and the confirmed pool outcome. Company removal hides its public profile and listings and ends hiring access; it retains the archived application, statistics and audit records described in section 15. Consented role-view counts include a listing identifier and a randomly generated view identifier; they do not include a candidate account ID.

Business team access. A business creator can invite accounts by email on an eligible business plan. We record the business, invited email, inviting account, expiry, acceptance and revocation. Invitations expire after seven days and do not provide hiring access until the invited, verified account accepts. Accepted membership uses the account identifier so an email change does not remove access. The business creator can see members' current account emails and revoke access. Hiring notifications are delivered to associated accounts under their notification preferences. Team membership does not share a member's password or private personal profile with colleagues.

Role Strength. When you choose to compare a CV, we process its text and any selected cover letter within Westmere to locate wording from published role requirements and skills. We use the same document evidence measure available to hiring teams, show source excerpts and can suggest position types from current vacancies. This comparison does not send the text to OpenAI, consume an AI request, create an application or notify an employer.

Recruitment agencies. We record reviewed agency classification, service regions and specialisms, private client identity and representative contact details, evidence and dates of recruitment authority, client approvals, reviewer feedback, vacancy assignments and revocations. Client authority evidence and confidential client names are restricted to authorised agency administrators, assigned recruiters where required and independent reviewers; they are not included in public listing projections. A direct agency application is first received by the named agency. Its candidate-visible client and recipient details are recorded at submission. Onward sharing with a client requires a lawful basis and the agency remains responsible for its separate handling. Revocation or expiry ends agency access and new recruitment messages under that mandate; the candidate’s submitted record and audit history are retained under the retention rules. Client authorisation does not share billing or grant client account ownership.

Founding launch. Employers and agencies register an account, accept business Terms and submit the usual verification form; no separate access request or consultation is required. Business details and vacancies remain private during founding onboarding. Verification or a subscription does not publish content: owner publication permission, independent review and a separate release after the public marketplace opens are required. We retain these permissions and review decisions. Candidate launch-update requests collect an email address, participant type and the time and version of email permission. These requests do not create an account, subscription or ongoing newsletter. Earlier founding-access requests and decisions remain private; their details are used only to administer the request and account access. We use a keyed, non-reversible network identifier and short-lived counters to limit abusive update requests. Contact us to withdraw an update request or ask about access, correction or deletion..

title: 3. How information reaches us and your choice to provide it
paragraphs: We collect information directly from you when you enter information, sign in, save a profile, request a tool, apply, report an experience or contact us. We also receive information from hiring teams about your application, from Stripe about subscriptions and payment events, and from service providers about authentication, email delivery, operation and security. If you include a referee or another person in a submission, we receive the details you include about that person.

We collect information by lawful and fair means and limit collection to what is reasonably necessary for our services or other lawful activities. If we receive information indirectly, we take reasonable steps to give any collection notice required by law, subject to lawful exceptions. If we receive unsolicited personal information that we could not lawfully have collected, we destroy or de-identify it where lawful and reasonable.

You can browse public roles and employer pages without an account, although ordinary network and security processing still occurs. You can make a general enquiry anonymously or under a pseudonym. Account-specific requests require identity verification. We need an email address and a name to complete an account, application material to submit an application, and necessary payment information through Stripe to provide a paid subscription. Without that information, the relevant account, application, subscription or account-specific response cannot be completed.

You do not need to save a CV in your profile to browse roles. Optional AI assistance and CV comparison can be declined. An account, application, subscription or support enquiry does not automatically subscribe you to marketing.

The current forms do not require a tax file number, Medicare number, passport, driver's licence, bank account details, medical certificate or criminal-history document. Do not include these in a CV or general enquiry. If a later lawful process needs identity or work-rights verification, we will explain the specific requirements and collection arrangements first. We do not adopt a government identifier as your Westmere account identifier.

If you include another person's details, tell them why you are providing those details and obtain their permission before providing their details. Do not submit someone else's CV or confidential information without authority. Westmere does not automatically contact referees because they are listed in a CV.

title: 4. Sensitive information and health information
paragraphs: Sensitive information can include health or disability information, racial or ethnic origin, religious or political beliefs, sexual orientation, trade-union or professional-association membership, criminal records and certain biometric information. Some of this information can appear in a CV or free-text application even though we do not ask for it.

Please leave out sensitive information unless it is necessary for the particular purpose. Where we need to collect sensitive information, we seek an informed and specific consent and collect only what is reasonably necessary, unless an applicable legal exception permits or requires collection. Simply accepting this policy is not that consent. We handle health information under applicable Victorian health privacy requirements as well as any applicable federal requirements.

We do not use sensitive information for marketing. Our CV assistance is instructed not to infer protected characteristics or assess suitability using them. That instruction does not guarantee that AI output will be accurate or free of bias. Remove sensitive details and other people's personal information before an AI request unless there is a clear, lawful need to include them.

If you have shared sensitive information by mistake or need an accessible way to use our services, contact our Privacy Officer. We will assess how to minimise, correct, restrict or remove the information consistently with applicable law.

title: 5. What we use information for
paragraphs: We use personal information to provide the features you request: establish and secure accounts; store profiles; find and display roles; process applications and withdrawals; give authorised hiring teams access to submitted material; display application activity and decisions; provide requested preparation tools; and manage subscription access and usage allowances.

We also use relevant information to answer enquiries and privacy requests, investigate complaints and suspected misuse, maintain and troubleshoot the service, reconcile billing, keep necessary financial and operational records, enforce lawful terms, and comply with legal obligations or valid legal processes. Where information is used to improve the service, we minimise it and use de-identified or aggregated information for usage analysis. Identifiable records are used only to investigate an identified service issue.

We do not sell candidate CVs, contact lists or application histories. A privately saved CV is not a publicly searchable candidate profile, and employers cannot browse the private CV database. We do not use your CV or application content to train our own general-purpose AI model or authorise third-party model training on that content.

We use or disclose information for the purpose of collection, another purpose you consent to, or another purpose permitted or required by law. For a secondary use without consent, any applicable reasonable-expectation and related-purpose requirements must be met; sensitive information attracts the stricter directly related purpose requirement. We do not treat a general reference to improving services as permission for an unrelated use.

For employer accounts, we use the submitted business and verification information to check identity and hiring authority, contact the listed business through its independently checked public contact, and record and notify you of the decision. Within 48 hours of a complete submission, we issue either a decision or an itemised request for further evidence. Hiring and business subscription purchases remain unavailable until verification is approved. Review decisions and the acting reviewer account are recorded in the shared staff audit.

title: 6. Your CV and applications
paragraphs: Text pasted into an editor starts in the current page's memory until you deliberately save, submit or request a server-based tool. Uploading a supported PDF or Word (.docx) CV is a separate action: the document is sent to Westmere and stored in private Supabase Storage, and readable text is extracted for your review and use in your profile. Upload history records earlier versions so you can distinguish and select them. Uploading does not itself send your CV to OpenAI, submit an application or make it publicly searchable. Please check extracted text, as layout, tables and scanned pages can contain extraction errors. Your browser features, extensions, spellcheck and device process text under their own settings.

The app does not save CV content in localStorage or sessionStorage. A saved profile and its CV documents are private to your account, subject to necessary authorised administration. Employers cannot browse your CV history. Document downloads require an authenticated account and a current permission check. A link alone does not grant access.

When you submit an application, we save your name, reviewed CV text, cover letter, application answers, role details and submission time in a separate snapshot. If you select an account CV or upload a new CV, the selected original file is copied privately into that application. Editing or deleting your profile CV later does not change the submitted text or file. Selecting a new CV for an application does not change your account’s base CV. Employers receive the submission you confirm and the current profile details described below, not your CV history.

Submitting a direct application shares its contents with the organisation identified for that role and its authorised hiring team. If the advertiser is a recruitment agency, the initial recipient is that agency. Check the advertiser's privacy notice and ask it about any proposed onward disclosure to an end employer. We do not automatically circulate your application to unrelated employers.

Withdrawal stops further hiring-team access to the application content through the current Westmere workspace. A limited record of the application and withdrawal can remain. Withdrawal does not automatically erase our records or recall copies already seen, copied or otherwise retained by the recipient. Ask us separately about deletion and contact the recipient about its own records.

If a role sends you to an external application website, that operator collects information under its own privacy arrangements. Westmere does not receive or track the external submission or its opening merely because you followed a link. Your browser will disclose ordinary connection information to that website.

Your profile contains first and last name, your verified account email and optional professional links. These details are private by default. When you apply, the authorised hiring team can see the current version of these profile details while your application remains active, including later corrections. Your submitted CV, cover letter, optional documents and declarations remain fixed as submitted. Withdrawing revokes further in-service access for that employer; it cannot retrieve copies they already lawfully downloaded.

The application form lets you review your profile, confirm a CV, add an optional cover letter and up to eight optional supporting files, and review the complete submission before confirming sharing. Optional declarations cover work rights, a driver’s licence and role-relevant certifications. Australian and New Zealand citizenship are two work-rights choices; other work-rights and sponsorship choices are available. These are candidate declarations, not verification by Westmere. Provide only relevant documents and omit unnecessary identity numbers. Unsubmitted attachments expire after 24 hours and are queued for deletion by the maintenance worker; submitted files remain separate from your CV library. Your library holds up to 20 CVs, five per history page, and deleting a library version does not remove a submitted copy.

title: 7. Application activity and experience reports
paragraphs: For applications submitted on Westmere, a recorded opening means an authorised hiring team member intentionally opened the detail view through the relevant feature. Loading an applicant list does not create that opening event. An opening is not proof of a full read, shortlisting or a job offer. Employer-entered decisions and messages can appear in the candidate's timeline. We provide in-site notifications and service-email updates for supported receipt, intentional-opening and application-stage events. A message or event recorded in the app is not evidence that its email reached an inbox or was read. Delivery can be delayed, blocked or affected by your email provider.

If you are an employer representative, your account identifier is associated with relevant application actions for authorisation and accountability. The candidate timeline shows the event, its time and any message; the current timeline does not display the actor identifier. We examine relevant activity records to investigate reported access, accuracy or misuse concerns.

Application-experience reports are recorded privately for moderation and are not automatically published. Only accepted reports can contribute to public employer response insights. The calculation uses a defined older application cohort, one eligible application per candidate and employer, excludes current organisation members, and requires at least ten eligible candidates before publishing an aggregate. A median response time also requires at least five responders. Silence must have been recently reconfirmed. Unresponsive means that more than half of the eligible cohort reports no meaningful reply after more than two calendar months; an automated receipt or recorded opening is not a meaningful reply. Stale summaries are withheld. These are self-reported experiences with limits, not a guarantee about an employer or a prediction for your application. Employers can appeal insights and candidates can seek correction. We do not publish CVs, contact details or identifiable reports as public employer reviews. Clearly labelled sample figures remain fictional.

Removing names alone does not make information anonymous. We consider whether small samples, dates, role details or other available information could identify someone before treating information as de-identified or publishing aggregate results.

When an employer confirms an interview candidate pool, Westmere closes applications for the role, records an interview-stage update for selected candidates, and records a not-proceeding update for remaining active candidates who do not already have an interview invitation or offer. The employer chooses the candidates; Westmere does not rank or select them automatically. Withdrawn applications receive no further hiring update. Each change creates a timeline event and in-site notice; email copies follow the candidate’s service-email preference and delivery controls. Archiving a role without confirming a pool records closure and does not reject each candidate.

Growth and higher employer tiers can deliberately open a requirements-evidence view for their role's active applications. Westmere locates literal wording from the role requirements in submitted CV and cover-letter text and shows attributed excerpts. Employers can sort the list by the percentage of eligible criteria with matching wording. This is a limited document-text measure that can miss equivalent wording or include irrelevant mentions; it does not establish suitability, verified skills or hiring probability. Sensitive criteria are excluded. The tool does not send candidate material to OpenAI or make hiring decisions. Opening this view records intentional first views through the same candidate transparency process as opening an individual application. Withdrawal revokes further access.

title: 8. CV comparison and automated processing
paragraphs: The Careers+ job-browser comparison uses CV text you supply or select from your private profile and named job skills or requirements to calculate overlap. With your confirmation, the text is processed by Westmere's server for the comparison. This comparison does not call OpenAI and does not itself change a saved CV. The result can filter or order the roles shown to you and show requirements found or not found in the supplied text. You can turn the comparison off and use ordinary search.

Careers+ Studio separately offers AI writing assistance and role-specific analysis as described in section 9. Automated subscription and allowance checks use account identifiers, subscription status, billing periods and usage records to decide whether paid tools are available and whether a request can proceed. You can contact us if you believe these checks or a comparison result are wrong.

These tools assist preparation and access to the service. The current platform does not use an automated score to submit, reject or shortlist candidates on an employer's behalf. A skill percentage is not a hiring probability or a complete assessment of ability. Hiring teams make their own recruitment decisions. If we introduce automated processing that makes or substantially and directly contributes to decisions significantly affecting people's rights or interests, we will update the disclosures and implement the applicable safeguards before use.

title: 9. Optional OpenAI assistance
paragraphs: When you upload a document to the Westmere assistant or Careers+ Studio, confirm the AI disclosure and request a task, we send OpenAI the extracted document text, your instructions, up to eight recent chat entries, and any supplied role title and description. Uploading alone is not consent to AI processing. Names, filenames or contact details contained in the supplied material are included unless you remove them from your source document before uploading. We do not separately send your account email or Stripe payment details as part of the AI prompt. Our server and hosting provider process the request on its way to and from OpenAI.

The sharing checkbox remembers your choice on this browser for guest use or the signed-in account. It stays selected for later messages, documents and chats you choose to send. You can uncheck it at any time to withdraw permission for future requests. Switching accounts does not carry the other account’s choice across. Uploading alone still does not send text to OpenAI, and withdrawing permission cannot recall a request already dispatched.

OpenAI returns suggestions such as an edited CV, cover letter or identified skills. Results are shown in your page for review and editing. For Careers+ customers, conversations save to your Westmere account when you send your first message. Saved chats include your messages, generated replies, extracted document text, filename and supplied role description. You can keep up to 10 chats, reopen them on another device and delete them through the Chats menu. Saved chats are private to your account and remain until you delete them or your account is deleted. You can still read or delete saved chats after your subscription ends. Profile saving and application submission are separate actions. Copying text or downloading a .txt result creates a copy under your control on your device or clipboard.

We set the OpenAI request's storage option to false. This is not Zero Data Retention: OpenAI's standard API arrangements can retain abuse-monitoring content for up to 30 days, model-related caching can retain data for up to 24 hours, and legal or safety exceptions may apply. OpenAI states that API content is not used for model training by default. We do not opt your CV content into training. See OpenAI's API data controls.

OpenAI processing can occur outside Australia. Declining AI assistance does not prevent ordinary browsing or direct applications. You can stop future AI processing by not making further requests; closing the page or withdrawing consent after dispatch cannot necessarily stop an already submitted request or remove provider records immediately. Contact us about an outstanding privacy concern. Review generated material before using it and correct inaccurate or unsupported claims.

The Westmere assistant and Careers+ Studio accept a PDF, DOCX or text file for temporary text extraction. Files sent to this extraction endpoint are processed in server memory and are not saved to the CV library; this is separate from deliberately saving a file in your profile. Extracted text is held in the current page's memory and, for Careers+ conversations, saved as part of the chat when you send a message. Review your original document before uploading and separately consent before sending its extracted text, instructions and recent chat to OpenAI. Guest and free-account chat entries and results remain in the current page session and are cleared on a reload or account change. Careers+ saved conversations remain in your account; starting a new chat resets the current conversation without deleting a saved chat. Upload safeguards use a daily keyed network identifier and short-lived processing reservation without the document text. Rate records are deleted by later upload requests once they are older than the current and previous UTC days; processing reservations expire after 90 seconds.

CV Review can produce an approximate document-readiness score from five writing criteria: clarity, structure, evidence, skills and alignment with a stated field. The criteria scores are summed to 100. Suggestions and scores are AI-generated opinions about the supplied document, can be wrong and are not validated hiring benchmarks or comparisons with other people. An unreadable or non-CV document is not assigned a numerical score. These reviews are not sent to hiring teams or used to accept, reject or shortlist candidates. You may correct and re-upload your source document, request another review within your allowance or contact us about inaccurate personal information.

Stop cancels an in-progress request. Requests stopped before a completed answer, and failed or incomplete requests, release their reserved allowance. A Stop action arriving after an answer has completed does not reverse that completed use. Westmere keeps a random request identifier, a keyed identity hash, the linked allowance reservation and its status to coordinate cancellation; it contains no document or chat text. These cancellation records are deleted by subsequent requests after 30 days. Stopping does not delete provider records already created.

title: 10. Emails marketing and other communications
paragraphs: Service communications

We use Supabase Auth with Resend SMTP to send requested one-time sign-in codes and account-email-change confirmations. Keep codes private. If you change your account email, the change is subject to the configured verification steps; entering a new address does not immediately replace the verified address. Google and Microsoft sign-in, where configured, are handled with the provider you select and Supabase. Your provider's own account and privacy arrangements also apply.

Resend also delivers a new-account welcome message and supported non-promotional application updates, such as receipt, first intentional opening and a hiring-stage change. These messages provide relevant links back to Westmere; we minimise their content and do not include your entire CV or application in ordinary notification email. The sending identity is Westmere Careers <support@westmere.com.au>. An email can reveal that you use a careers service to anyone with access to your inbox or its notifications.

Employers receive in-site notices of new applications and relevant activity. Grouping and duplicate controls reduce repeated notifications. We send communications to answer an enquiry or privacy request, report an account security issue, administer a payment or meet a legal notice requirement. Stripe can send its own billing communications according to its settings. In-site events, provider acceptance, delivery and reading are different things; we do not guarantee inbox placement or that a recipient has read an update.
Optional saved-search alerts and marketing

Saving a search and choosing its email alerts is optional. Alerts use the filters you save to send a daily or weekly digest of newly approved matching jobs; no new matches means no digest. CV content is not saved in these alert filters or included in alert emails. We record your affirmative alert choice and let you pause, change, delete or unsubscribe from an individual search. A deliberately requested preview is sent only to your own verified account email and is subject to an abuse-prevention limit. Job alerts are treated as commercial messages where the Spam Act applies.

Candidates, employers and agencies have a marketing email preference in Account Settings covering Westmere news, offers, launch announcements and employer onboarding invitations. The preference starts enabled unless this address has already opted out. An enabled default, account creation, application, purchase or reading this policy does not itself establish consent to send. We require a separate recorded consent basis. Saving the enabled marketing preference records an affirmative choice; you can disable it at any time. A public supplier invitation may support a relevant supplier introduction, but is not permission for an ongoing newsletter. We do not use SMS marketing or telemarketing.

Commercial messages identify Westmere and provide valid contact details and an unsubscribe button. The button opens a confirmation page without requiring a fee, sign-in, reply or extra personal information. Confirmed opt-outs and Settings withdrawals immediately update a restricted administrator unsubscribe register and cancel pending Westmere marketing, including launch and onboarding invitations. Authorised administrators can also record a request manually, including for an address without an account. We retain the address, choice, time, source, request reason and limited audit history to honour that choice. We action valid marketing unsubscribe requests within five working days and keep the facility and sender contact information available for at least 30 days after sending. You can also contact support@westmere.com.au. Bounces, complaints and provider suppressions can stop further email attempts.

Unsubscribing from job alerts or other marketing does not stop a requested sign-in code or necessary non-promotional account, application, billing, security or legal message. We do not add promotional material to a service message to evade marketing rules. In-site notifications remain available when an email cannot be sent.
Delivery records and tracking

Email infrastructure records sending, delivery, bounce, complaint and security events. These events do not necessarily show that a person read a message. Authentication links must not be modified by marketing click tracking. We do not currently implement marketing open pixels or behavioural email tracking. If optional tracking is introduced, we will explain what it collects and offer any legally required choice before enabling it. Providers perform automated spam, phishing and security analysis through their services and security subprocessors.

Employer notification preferences. Hiring representatives can choose new-application notices, application milestones at 25, 50, 100 and 200 non-withdrawn applications, vacancy-closing reminders and team follow-up reminders after a chosen 1–60 days without a recorded employer update. Optional email copies are off unless enabled. These reminders go to the hiring team; they do not automatically contact a candidate, change a stage or claim an assessment occurred. Business welcome and verification outcomes are essential service notices and can be sent in-site and to the verified account email. Email content is kept brief and directs you back to your account. Changes to preferences affect future notices; previously recorded notices remain until removed through the account-closure or privacy-request process.

Clearing an update from the bell menu hides it from that menu and marks it read. It remains available in your paginated Notifications history on your profile. A materially updated notice can reappear in the menu.

title: 11. Service providers and other recipients
paragraphs: We disclose relevant information only to recipients needed for a described purpose or otherwise permitted by law. Our principal service providers are:
Vercel: website hosting, server execution, content delivery and infrastructure security. Requests for account, CV, application and preparation features pass through this hosting infrastructure.

Supabase: account authentication, private profiles, CV documents and extracted text, CV history, applications, activity events, organisation permissions, experience reports, saved jobs and searches, notification and delivery records, employer media and supporting documents, subscription references and allowance records.

Resend: authentication email through Supabase SMTP and supported welcome, application-update, opt-in saved-search and consent-based marketing messages, including associated message, address, delivery, webhook and security information.

Stripe: hosted Checkout and Customer Portal, payments, subscription administration, fraud prevention and financial compliance. We send your email and Westmere account reference to establish the customer relationship. Westmere does not collect or store full card numbers or card security codes in its application database. Stripe processes payment-service instructions from Westmere and also processes information independently for its own legal, security and payment-service duties.
OpenAI: the optional, expressly requested preparation assistance described in section 9.

Google or Microsoft: if you choose their available sign-in option, the selected provider authenticates your identity and shares the information permitted by the sign-in request. We receive identity information through Supabase; Westmere does not receive your provider password. Provider privacy notices explain their independent account processing. Your employer or school controls the policies for a work or school account it supplies.

These providers use the affiliates and subprocessors identified in their published service arrangements. A supplier's list can include optional products that Westmere does not use; appearing on a supplier list does not mean every supplier receives every CV. Providers' own legal obligations can also affect their processing.

Other recipients can include the hiring organisation you apply to and its authorised team; our authorised personnel or contractors who need information for operations or support; professional advisers assisting with a specific legal, accounting or security matter; and regulators, courts, law-enforcement bodies or other persons where disclosure is required or lawfully authorised. We assess requests and limit disclosure to what is appropriate for the lawful purpose.

If a business transfer or restructure is proposed, we assess the lawful basis and safeguards before sharing personal information, minimise due-diligence information and notify affected users where required. A transaction is not an unrestricted permission to sell or repurpose CVs.

title: 12. Overseas storage access and disclosure
paragraphs: Our services use international infrastructure. The currently selected Supabase database, Auth and private Storage are in Tokyo, Japan, as is the configured Vercel application compute. Supabase describes core hosting and backups as regional, while support, operations, logging and content delivery can occur elsewhere. A selected compute or sending region does not mean every recipient or copy is in that region.

Resend's configured sending region is also Tokyo, but its sending region does not determine storage residency. Resend states that message content, delivery logs and related customer records are stored in the United States. Its current standard email/log retention is 30 days on Free, Pro and Scale plans; different contractual settings and backup or legal retention may apply. See Resend's data location and retention information.

Our selected database, authentication and private file storage operate in Tokyo, Japan. Provider operational, support, payment and delivery processing also takes place in the United States, Singapore and European Union locations identified in the linked provider residency and subprocessor records. Supabase’s public operational-log documentation does not enumerate each logging country. Google and Microsoft sign-in and provider delivery networks operate across the locations listed in their privacy and subprocessor records. We do not configure the service for Australia-only processing. For a request about a particular recipient or country, the Privacy Officer supplies the current provider information and identifies any location the provider has not disclosed.

Vercel and the other providers route requests through their international networks. We review the actual recipient, purpose, access and contractual controls to determine our overseas disclosure duties. Network transit and disclosure to an independent recipient have different legal treatment; selecting a hosting region does not remove those duties.

For overseas disclosures subject to APP 8, we take reasonable steps to ensure appropriate handling consistent with the APPs unless a lawful exception applies. Measures include reviewing the purpose and information involved, provider contracts and data-processing terms, security and access controls, onward-processing arrangements and relevant overseas risks. We remain accountable to the extent Australian law requires. We also address applicable Victorian health-information transfer requirements, including transfers outside Victoria.

Overseas laws may differ from Australian laws and may permit authorities to require access. We do not rely on your general use of the service or acceptance of this policy as a waiver of APP 8 protections. Any reliance on a specific informed-consent exception would require a separate explanation and consent satisfying that law.

The country of an employer recipient depends on the organisation and its team arrangements. Ask the advertiser about offshore recruitment teams or onward transfers before applying if this affects your decision. Your own email provider can also process messages internationally. Contact our Privacy Officer about current arrangements or a location concern.

title: 13. Cookies local storage and website technology
paragraphs: The current website uses first-party browser storage for the following functions:
Appearance: westmere-theme in localStorage stores your Auto, Light or Dark preference.

Saved jobs and searches: signed-in saved-job identifiers and saved-search filters are stored against your account in our database. Signing out does not delete these account records. Older development versions stored job identifiers on the device under westmere-saved. That legacy value remains until cleared and does not authorise saving jobs while signed out.

Sign-in: Supabase session cookies, including cookies whose names begin with sb- and relate to authentication, support signed-in requests and session refresh. Authentication refresh replaces session cookies while a session is active; signing out ends that browser’s session.

Guest AI allowance: after you request a guest review, the first-party westmere-ai-preview cookie stores a signed random identifier for up to one year. It is HTTP-only and supports the free-use allowance and abuse controls. It is not an advertising identifier. A verified free account has a separate allowance. Clearing or blocking the cookie can affect the guest preview; other daily safeguards still apply. We do not store your CV or AI result in this cookie or localStorage.

The appearance preference and any legacy saved-role browser value remain until you change or clear them or your browser removes them; they are not automatically removed by signing out. You can manage or remove cookies and site storage in your browser. Signed-in features require authentication cookies. Clearing device storage does not delete a saved profile, submitted application or provider record.

We do not currently add advertising pixels, third-party behavioural analytics, session-replay tools or social-media tracking to the app. Fonts and illustrations are served locally. Hosting security and requested third-party services can still process connection information. Stripe's hosted pages and external employer websites have their own cookies and privacy arrangements. We review any proposed non-essential tracking before introducing it and obtain consent where required.

Optional first-party Discovery analytics. Unless you choose Allow analytics, we do not record Discovery events. Your choice is stored in the HTTP-only westmere-analytics cookie for up to one year and can be changed through Privacy & analytics choices in the footer. A browser Global Privacy Control signal also prevents this optional collection. The choice applies to this browser; another browser or device has its own choice. Declining does not affect job search or applications.

When allowed, we count displayed job-search result pages containing an employer’s roles and employer-search pages containing its profile, listing views and company-profile views, with the employer identifier, Melbourne calendar day, event type, a recognised career keyword if the search exactly matches our allowlist, and an approximate state or territory supplied by Vercel from the request’s public IP. Overseas and unavailable regions are categorised separately. We do not request device geolocation or use the job-search location as the visitor’s location. VPNs and network routing can make a region inaccurate. Arbitrary search text, account identifiers, CV content, raw IP addresses and exact coordinates are not stored in these analytics aggregates or shown to employers.

A separate daily keyed network identifier limits analytics misuse. It is derived on the server from the network address using a secret key; the raw address is not stored in that ledger. It rotates daily and the rate-limit record is removed within 48 hours by subsequent analytics requests or scheduled housekeeping. This short-lived pseudonymous safeguard is separate from employer analytics and is not available to employers. Hosting and security providers can separately process raw connection details as described elsewhere in this policy.

Discovery aggregates are held for up to 12 months, then removed through scheduled housekeeping. Access is restricted to the verified employer’s authorised hiring team with a qualifying business plan, and authorised Westmere personnel administering the service. State-filtered totals, regional and recognised keyword breakdowns include the first recorded event; no identities or individual browsing trails are supplied. Totals count events, not unique people or all visitors. Repeated visits, consent choices, blocking, automated traffic and regional uncertainty affect coverage. These reports are not public employer-response statistics, application records or individual recruitment decisions.

Employer sign-in can set the HTTP-only wm-business-intent cookie for up to 15 minutes to return you from Google or Microsoft to business-account completion. It contains a fixed flow label, not your company details or Terms acceptance. Provider authentication is followed by confirmation and acceptance for the authenticated account.

A random page-view identifier prevents duplicate collection from repeated delivery of the same event and is removed after 48 hours by subsequent analytics requests. Recognised career queries are grouped with an approximate visitor state; employer-name searches use a generic category rather than storing the entered company name. No arbitrary query text is retained in Discovery. Events are recorded when an eligible page is displayed after analytics is allowed. Signed-in business and staff traffic is excluded. A zero means no recorded events for that category and selected period, rather than an absence of actual visits.

The assistant’s closed/open preference uses sessionStorage under westmere-assistant-closed. It lasts for the current browser tab session, survives refresh, and contains no CV or chat content. Australian locality names and centres from GeoNames and job titles from the ABS OSCA directory support suggestions and distance filters. The directories are bundled with Westmere; typing a search does not send it to a third-party autocomplete service. Distance means straight-line kilometres between locality centres, not a driving route.

Discovery reports consented event counts from the first recorded appearance, including recognised search keywords with one appearance. Employers see aggregate counts for their own organisation, selected broad regions and each keyword’s most frequent region. We do not record arbitrary search text as keywords, exact visitor locations, or identifiable search histories in these reports. Christmas Island and Cocos (Keeling) Islands are grouped with Western Australia for this reporting; they remain Australian external territories. Unknown and overseas regions are shown separately. Recognised, consented search terms also inform site-wide popular-search suggestions. We count a search once, limit repeated events from a daily rotating network hash, retain these events for 30 days, and publish suggestions only after the minimum aggregate sample is met. We do not publish arbitrary search text or individual search histories.

The Assistant stores the sharing checkbox preference in localStorage under westmere-assistant-sharing-v1, scoped to guest use or your account identifier. It stores only the accepted preference, not document text or chat content, and remains until you uncheck the box or clear this browser’s storage. Browsers that block storage can still accept a choice for the open chat.

title: 14. Security
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organisational steps to protect personal information against misuse, interference, loss and unauthorised access, modification or disclosure. Controls include encrypted HTTPS connections, provider-managed database encryption, authenticated and permission-scoped access, database row-level security, server-side protection of secret credentials, input validation, verified payment webhooks and controls against inappropriate caching of private responses.

Private profiles are restricted to the relevant account; application access is restricted to the candidate and authorised members of the hiring organisation, with necessary operational access for authorised service administration. Administrative credentials can permit wider access for legitimate operations and must be protected accordingly. We limit personal information in diagnostics and do not intentionally log CV text, one-time sign-in credentials or full payment details.

No service can guarantee complete security. Keep your email account and device secure, do not share sign-in codes or authorised document links and sign out on shared devices. Contact our Privacy Officer promptly about suspected unauthorised access. This policy does not claim that Westmere itself holds a provider's security certification or that information is end-to-end encrypted against necessary service-provider processing.

Email sign-in codes expire after 15 minutes and are single-use. Use the newest code. An email code proves access to that email address, not ownership of a business. Converting an account type requires a recent sign-in, confirmation of the account and business details, and independent verification before hiring access. We do not reassign an email or business account based solely on an unsolicited support request.

title: 15. Retention deletion and account closure
paragraphs: Your profile and private CV library remain in your account until you delete an available CV version or request account closure or deletion. Submitted applications are separate records and remain until handled through a deletion request or account-closure review. A job listing expires after 40 days unless it has an earlier closing date. Expiry and employer removal archive the listing; they do not erase applications, statistics or audit history.

Different records have different lifecycles. A profile is distinct from an application snapshot; billing records are distinct from a CV; an AI allowance record is distinct from a prompt. We assess each category separately. When information is no longer needed and no legal retention obligation applies, we take reasonable steps to securely destroy or effectively de-identify it. De-identified information is retained only where identification is no longer reasonably possible in the circumstances.

Free AI allowance identifiers are retained to enforce the relevant trial. Guest records older than one year and unsuccessful or abandoned trial attempts older than 30 days are eligible for deletion during subsequent quota reservations. Completed account-trial records remain for the account allowance and are removed with account deletion. Daily abuse identifiers are keyed and change each day; raw IP addresses are not stored in the trial ledger.

Request access, a copy, account closure or deletion through the Privacy Officer at support@westmere.com.au. Start with your account email and the records concerned. Within 30 days, we confirm the action taken or identify each record retained, its purpose, legal basis and deletion or next review date. We verify control of the account before releasing or deleting private records. The app does not currently provide a self-service account export or complete account-deletion button.

Records subject to an active legal hold, complaint, fraud investigation or payment dispute are restricted to that matter until it ends and its applicable retention duty expires. Financial records required by law are kept for the period that law requires. An unsubscribe suppression record remains to prevent further marketing until you revoke that instruction or the contact address is permanently removed. These grounds do not justify retaining an unrelated CV. Our response to a deletion request identifies the specific records and applicable period.

Deletion from active systems does not immediately erase protected backups. Backup copies follow the provider’s configured backup expiry and are not used for ordinary account access. For a deletion request, we identify the applicable backup expiry from the provider configuration in our response and reapply the deletion instruction after any restore. Records independently held by a payment provider or hiring employer follow that recipient’s legal duties; Westmere cannot delete them directly.

Closing a Westmere account, withdrawing an application, unsubscribing from marketing and cancelling a Stripe subscription are distinct actions. Tell us if you also need help cancelling a subscription; an unresolved payment obligation is not a general reason to retain unrelated CV information. We cannot erase information independently retained by an employer, email recipient or device owner, but will assist with requests to recipients where required by law.

Business Terms acceptance evidence and separately accepted order references are retained while needed to administer the agreement, establish its version, resolve a dispute or comply with law. Verification evidence and contact information are limited to the review, related complaints and appropriate audit retention; account closure does not automatically require destruction of records that we lawfully need. Discovery aggregates and its short-lived network rate records have the separate limits described in section 13.

title: 16. Access correction and other requests
paragraphs: You can view or edit available profile details in your account. You may also ask our Privacy Officer for access to personal information we hold about you, a copy in a practical format, correction or annotation of inaccurate information, or consideration of a deletion or restriction request. An Australian privacy access right is not dependent on having a paid subscription. We will assist with accessible request methods where reasonably practicable.

We seek only enough information to verify identity or the authority of a representative. Please start with your account email and a description of the request; do not email identity documents unless we arrange a necessary and secure method. You do not need to use a particular form or explain why you want access. We consider information held on our behalf by providers as part of our response rather than automatically referring every request to them.

We respond to access and correction requests within 30 days of receipt. Applicable statutory time limits take priority. Where the Victorian private-sector health-record access regime applies, access requests must be answered without unreasonable delay and within 45 days; correction requests within 30 days. If we anticipate a delay, we explain it and the next steps without extending a statutory deadline by notice alone.

We do not charge to make a request or to correct information. Before work that incurs an access charge, we provide the amount, calculation and legal basis and obtain your agreement; statutory fee limits apply. If access or correction is refused in whole or part, we provide written reasons where lawful, explain complaint options, and consider another way to provide access. You can ask us to associate a statement with information you dispute. Where required, we take reasonable steps on request to notify relevant previous recipients of a correction.

We assess additional rights under other laws where they apply. This policy does not promise that overseas privacy regimes apply merely because a provider operates in that jurisdiction, or that every record can be deleted immediately on demand.

title: 17. Young people
paragraphs: Jobseekers can include young people. Where consent is needed, we consider whether a young person can understand the proposed handling and make a meaningful choice; where necessary, consent or assistance from a parent, guardian or other lawful representative is required. We limit information to what is necessary and do not treat parental involvement as unrestricted access to a young person's account.

We do not collect identity documents or dates of birth as a standard sign-in requirement, and we do not claim that the current sign-in flow verifies age. If you are concerned that a young person has supplied information without an appropriate basis, contact our Privacy Officer. We will assess the situation and take appropriate protective steps. Paid and AI features must also meet any applicable age, consent and provider requirements.

title: 18. Questions complaints and policy changes
paragraphs: Contact our Privacy Officer using section 1 and describe your concern, the relevant service or information, and the outcome you seek. Complaints are free. We assess the complaint, investigate the records concerned and provide a substantive response within 30 days. If the matter is unresolved, that response identifies the remaining issues, further investigation and next review date.

If you are not satisfied, or we have not responded within 30 days, you may contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner about a matter within its jurisdiction. Complaints about Victorian health-information handling can be made to the Health Complaints Commissioner. The Office of the Victorian Information Commissioner handles matters within the Victorian public sector privacy regime, including relevant contracted services where that regime applies. You can report suspected unlawful commercial messages to the Australian Communications and Media Authority. A regulator determines whether it can deal with a particular complaint.

If we suspect a data breach, we take steps to contain it, assess risk, remedy the issue and reduce harm. Where the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme applies, we take all reasonable steps to complete the assessment within 30 calendar days of the relevant suspicion arising. For an eligible breach, we notify the OAIC and affected people as soon as practicable unless a lawful exception applies. A notification explains the incident, affected information and recommended protective steps. Other applicable notification duties are addressed as required.

We update this policy when our practices, providers or legal obligations change and show the revised date. For a material change, we take reasonable steps to notify affected people before the new handling begins where required. A new policy does not retrospectively create consent for an incompatible use. A copy of this policy is available free of charge, and we will take reasonable steps to provide it in another appropriate format on request.
